module_reviews.result: 认证后记录请求体，连接截止及 hijack 生命周期，新增管理刷新路由沿用管理密钥认证；图片格式回调只改变返回 JSON 的 url/base64 字段，无新增下载；SDK 请求身份快照送既有用量链。
目录刷新仅对既有默认或显式配置源发 GET/读取本地文件，大小受限，结果经 JSON 校验写入内存。模型条目及提示作为客户端目录数据，完整结构差异与六种独有提示变更已读；相同原文按哈希复用，未执行其中指令。
Codex 限流分类、Retry-After、WebSocket 断连重试和 Home 会话释放沿用既有上游/会话边界；Devin apply_patch 校验后仅 JSON 包装工具参数，无本地执行，诊断仅输出固定代码和形状。
Vertex partialArgs 为有界内存 JSON 组装，Gemini/Claude 思考签名与协议转换沿既有输出；用量身份捕获保持既有插件/配置 Redis 路径，无新增外传目标。测试全文仅静态阅读，未执行或作功能质量结论。

dependencies.install_behavior: No changed module versions, sources, install hooks or central build steps. Approved unchanged dependencies reused; no recursive certification of unexecuted development/CI/toolchain.

catalog_read_method.note: All raw diff structure and every unique string delta actually read. Exact repeated strings and unchanged approved baseline spans referenced by immutable hashes; raw pages 164–927 are NOT claimed to have been displayed verbatim.

limits: No vulnerability, bug, correctness, quality or test-assertion audit; no scans/tests/upstream execution.
Unchanged baseline dependencies and build/runtime boundary reused; remote future catalog content, independently configured plugins and external services are not certified.
CI builds occur only after source approval and are publication evidence only. No deployment or restart.
